notes: All 69 pieces are listed and the counts match the parts list (18 lines). Colours are Black, except the two 4x6 plates and four 1x6 tiles (Light Bluish Gray) and the two antennas (White).

The booklet images are dark and small, so many rests_on lists are my best reading of the pictures. The base layout, the stud coverage under the corner bricks, and which brick sits on which in the 1x3/2x3 layers are inferred.
Steps 1-2: the two 4x10 plates sit side by side. The 1x8 tiles frame them, and the printed tile is the front one.
Steps 3-4: the grey 4x6 plates sit on both base plates, and the grey 1x6 tiles frame them.

Step 5: the jumper plates and the 1x4 and 1x2 tiles sit on the grey plates. The first 2x2 plate (b13) sits on the grey plates. The second 2x2 plate (b23, step 6) sits on b13 and carries the curved brick.
Step 8 (7 layers): each layer has one 1x3 and one 2x3 side by side, with the pair swapped from layer to layer. I treated every brick as resting on both bricks of the layer below.
Steps 9-11: each 2x2 brick sits on the corner brick below it, and each corner brick sits on the 2x2 brick below it. The 1x1 tiles cover leftover open studs.
Steps 12-16: the twin top is built as two 1x1 columns and a 1x3 column with a 1x2 stack above it. The antennas plug onto the top 1x2 brick (b67).
No other_joins: every connection is a stud/anti-stud stack. Positions are null.
